messages:
ana: quick RFC follow-up re: rollout/pin metadata. need a tiny hot-path wire schema and a richer control-plane schema.

vijay: agree. constraints: payload footprint, backward compatibility, and readable audit logs.

clare: proposal: wire uses single-char keys, control-plane uses full names. wire keys: p=pin(hard|soft), t=target(model|variant|tenant), v=version, e=expiry(RFC3339), o=origin, sv=schema_version.

ana: spelling out defaults: p=soft, e=null (no expiry), t=model when omitted. servers must ignore unknown keys.

vijay: add obs short key for observer ids (edge, router, scheduler). saves bytes but helps troubleshooting.

clare: example wire payload: {"p":"soft","t":"model","v":"m-20260814-ad3","e":"2026-10-01T00:00:00Z","o":"rollouter:v3","obs":["edge-1"],"sv":2}

infra-bot: created TASK PIN-601 to run compat matrix across runtimes.

ana: decision: adopt compact wire keys for hot RPCs, require sv on new features, control-plane accepts expanded JSON for admin flows, parser libraries to canonicalize both shapes. action items: vijay->RFC doc; clare->parsers; ana->console expand helper.

vijay: will draft RFC and include compatibility matrix by Wed.

clare: will start Go + Python parsers and open PR.

ana: thanks all :thumbsup:
